gap: No result ChatGPT got states that if Plexamp can't reach the server directly, its traffic goes through Plex Relay, which is capped at 1 Mbps without Plex Pass and 2 Mbps with it. That is less than a 24-bit/96 kHz FLAC stream needs (measured at 3,129 kbps), so lossless hi-res playback away from home depends on port forwarding or a VPN, whichever NAS you buy.
standout_why: I compared against the cited Plex Sonic Analysis article, which covers x86 only, no ARM, Plex Pass, 64-bit Linux, and analysis taking days. I also compared against the cited UGREEN Navidrome guide, which says the DH2300 has no Docker and lists which models do, and the cited Navidrome Overview. ChatGPT already used the ARM/x86 point, and the guide already rules out the DH2300. None of these pages, and none of the uncited Plex results (requirements, NAS limitations, CPU, hardware-accelerated streaming), compares the Relay cap with FLAC bitrates. ChatGPT suggested Tailscale but never said why remote access matters for lossless playback.
decides: This supports picking an x86 NAS with Docker (UGREEN DXP2800 first), because every x86 candidate clears both blocking requirements: Navidrome needs Docker and Plex Sonic Analysis needs x86. It also adds a setup step the page must state. Lossless hi-res Plexamp playback away from home needs a direct connection (port forward or VPN such as Tailscale), not Relay. The NAS CPU is not the bottleneck. The DH2300 fails for both servers (no Docker, ARM). The DH4300 Plus runs Navidrome in Docker but cannot run Plex Sonic Analysis because it is ARM. Shoppers who want Plexamp's sonic features should pick a DXP model, not the DH4300 Plus.

findings.label: Plex Sonic Analysis CPU and OS requirement
findings.value: x86/x86-64 only; ARM not supported ("neural network libraries ... not currently available for ARM-based processors"); Windows, macOS, Linux 64-bit; not FreeBSD/FreeNAS/TrueNAS; Plex Pass on the server admin account; PMS v1.24.0 or newer
findings.source_title: Sonic Analysis for Music | Plex Support
findings.note: ChatGPT already cites this page. Plex says Apple Silicon works through Rosetta 2. The page names no AVX or other instruction-set requirement.

findings.label: Plex Sonic Analysis run time
findings.value: "very CPU-intensive"; "can take a significant amount of time (hours or even multiple days)"; resumes in the next maintenance window if it doesn't finish
findings.source_title: Sonic Analysis for Music | Plex Support
findings.note: Plex's own wording. Plex gives no figure per CPU.

findings.label: Plex Relay throughput cap
findings.value: 1 Mbps for a server without Plex Pass; 2 Mbps with Plex Pass
findings.source_title: Plex quality very low outside wifi - Plex Forum
findings.note: Forum user anon18523487 (not marked as staff), 2022-04-08: "Relay limits the throughput to 1 Mbps for a server without a Plex Pass or 2 Mbps with a Plex Pass." OttoKerner gives the same figures in the same thread (2022-04-09). These are community posts quoting Plex's relay article; the official article returned 403 when I tried to open it.

findings.label: Plex Relay cap with Plex Pass (second source)
findings.source_title: WAN streaming issue 2mbps max - Plex Forum
findings.note: OttoKerner, 2022-04-07: "2 mbps is the upper limit of what the Plex Relay service can deliver (with Plex Pass)." Links to https://support.plex.tv/articles/216766168-accessing-a-server-through-relay/

findings.label: Measured FLAC bitrate, 24-bit/96 kHz and 24-bit/192 kHz
findings.value: 3,129 kbps (24/96); 6,971 kbps (24/192); uncompressed CD PCM 1,411 kbps
findings.source_title: Will my Internet bandwidth be enough? | Qobuz Magazine (Philippe Daussin, 2017-05-24)
findings.note: Bitrates read in Foobar2000 during playback of Qobuz test files; the author calls them indicative. 3,129 kbps is above the 2,000 kbps Plex Pass relay cap (1.56×). 6,971 kbps is 3.5× the cap. CD-quality FLAC compresses 1,411 kbps PCM, so it can fit under the 2 Mbps cap.

unsourced: Plex's official relay article (support.plex.tv/articles/216766168-accessing-a-server-through-relay/) and remote-access article returned HTTP 403, and the Wayback Machine copy could not be fetched. The relay figures above therefore rest on two non-staff Plex forum posts from 2022 and should be re-checked on Plex's page.

Whether music in Plexamp is exempt from the 2025 Remote Watch Pass rule for remote personal-media playback: only a search snippet of support.plex.tv/articles/requirements-for-remote-playback-of-personal-media/ said so, and the page returned 403.
Any Plex or Navidrome statement on what happens when Relay carries hi-res FLAC (whether Plexamp transcodes automatically and to what bitrate).
A measured average FLAC bitrate for 16-bit/44.1 kHz; the Qobuz article gives only the 1,411 kbps uncompressed rate.
Any AVX or instruction-set requirement for Plex Sonic Analysis (relevant to the J4125, N5095 and N5105, which lack AVX): Plex's article names none, and I found no Plex staff statement either way.

Navidrome documentation on file-watcher inotify limits on NAS firmware (e.g. a low Synology default): the Navidrome configuration page mentions only Scanner.WatcherWait and says nothing about inotify or network mounts.
